title: Aufbau principle and configuration exceptions
basic_overview: Aufbau is a filling guide; actual ground states can deviate when subshell energies are close.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Fill by energy, then check Cr/Cu stability.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Apply n+l. 2. Lower n first when n+l ties. 3. Write configuration. 4. Check known exceptions.
extra_info_content.factors: Exchange stabilisation and electron repulsion can favour half-filled/full d subshells.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
extra_info_content.exam_focus: Cr/Cu configurations and transition-metal ion formation.
